_doc: The intended run profile the pre-run gate (scripts/prerun_gate.py) holds the next VM run to. Change it ON PURPOSE, in the same commit as the vm_lib.sh / code change it describes: the gate fails when vm_lib.sh exports a value this file does not declare, when a module the run never imports is not listed below with a reason, when a whole-file json load appears in the run path that is not listed below, or when the memory projection crosses the kill line. Audit 2026-10-09 (pipeline_gate).
description: Oracle VM full run, FORECLOSURE_ROLE=vm, launched with vm_run.sh --stop-before-publish under a pinned commit; published after review with vm_resume.sh --publish-only.

flags_notes.VISION_PROVIDER: vm_lib.sh picks gemini when a Gemini key file exists, else anthropic; the declared value is vm_lib.sh's text default
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_STREETVIEW: exported only when a maps key file exists (free tier clamp 9,000/month)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_NC_HARRIS_ROD: browser-rendered register platforms stay OFF until a run has measured their memory and time (HANDOFF item 82)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_NC_HARRIS_MARRIAGE: Mecklenburg/Carteret Marriage index in the same guest browser (rod/nc_harris.marriage_search); a second browser lookup per lead (measured 15-20 s, 540 MB peak on 2026-10-09), so OFF with the Harris flag it depends on
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_SC_LIEN_SWEEP: county-wide AcclaimWeb lien sweep (Horry, Pickens), enrichment_register_lien_sweep; plain HTTP, cached, newest month first inside FORECLOSURE_LIEN_SWEEP_BUDGET_S (needs the main.py wiring line in docs/audit_2026-10-09/top80_logan_harris.md)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_GENERIC_ROD_BUDGET_S: the generic register pass's own budget (enrichment_generic_rod); it only applies in full once main.py runs generic_rod under its own _await_capped (audit 2026-10-09 additions_verify wiring), before that the ROD group's 900 s cap still cancels it (its counts are then logged as generic_rod.cancelled)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_REGISTER_SWEEP: county-wide Date Range sweeps of the ten Cott v4 counties (rod/cott_sweep.py): adverse kinds -> raw.rod_lien_sweep, the MARRIAGES index -> raw.marriage_license, each for the window swept only; cached in data/county_sweeps/, newest window first, per-county budget FORECLOSURE_REGISTER_SWEEP_BUDGET_S; the cotthosting.com tenants share one host so their sweeps queue (about 2.5 min per county per 1.75 years of data measured); runs inside enrichment_register_checks (same wiring)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_REGISTER_CHECKS: marriage-index check (enrichment_register_checks) on the six Cott v4 tenants with a MARRIAGES index; needs main.py to run it after generic_rod (wiring in docs/audit_2026-10-09/top80_register_other.md); also needs FORECLOSURE_NC_COTT_ROD=1
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_GIS_FILL: county parcel-record fill (gis_fill): NC OneMap + 15 SC county layers, deed book/page, short legal, value, acreage, and the Orangeburg qPayBill account-to-parcel join; plain HTTP, 40 parcels a request, 2 s a host; needs the main.py wiring line in docs/audit_2026-10-09/top80_fill.md
flags_notes.GENERIC_ROD_COUNTY_CONCURRENCY: register counties read side by side; each county is its own host and the adapters hold a per-host lock, so never two requests on one host
flags_notes.OBITUARY_LOOKUPS: live obituary name lookups (Echovita / Find a Grave) per dead-owner lead: OFF until the owner decides (HANDOFF item 82)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_MECKLENBURG_DELINQUENT: Mecklenburg delinquent XLSX (one-year balances, +29k rows, +12 min geocoding): OFF by the 10/7 decision (vm_lib 9edff1f3)
flags_notes.RICHLAND_PARCEL_MAX: Richland map-viewer lookups per run (one host, about 4 s a row, inside RESOLVER_PHASE_MAX_SECONDS 2,400); HOT and WARM rows first
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_COUNTY_LIEN_SWEEP: county-wide adverse-instrument sweeps of 23 counties (20 Courthouse Computer Systems classic ASP, Beaufort LRSearch, Sumter GovOS CountyFusion, Oconee GovOS/Kofile PublicSearch) (enrichment_county_lien_sweep, rod/county_sweeps): plain HTTP and one WebSocket, cached in data/county_sweeps, 'screened, none found' only for the window read; needs the main.py wiring line in unwired_wire_pending
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_COUNTY_MARRIAGE_SWEEP: Beaufort NC Marriages index swept by date (about 275 licences a year) and matched to person owners; part of the same pass
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_COUNTY_SWEEP_BUDGET_S: each county's register reads inside the sweep pass (a cold Sumter sweep took 395 s on 2026-10-09, the others 30 to 55 s; later runs read only the new end)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_SC_COUNTYFUSION_ROD: Sumter by owner name through GovOS CountyFusion (rod/sc_countyfusion): no-credential 'Login as Guest' and a plain Accept click-through, about 5 s a lookup once the session is held; 30 lookups a run (FORECLOSURE_SC_COUNTYFUSION_ROD_MAX)
flags_notes.FORECLOSURE_NC_LRSEARCH_ROD: Beaufort by owner name through CCS LRSearch (rod/nc_lrsearch): open, no login or CAPTCHA; 30 lookups a run (FORECLOSURE_NC_LRSEARCH_ROD_MAX)

GRANDFATHER_CARRIED.why: main.run json.loads the whole prior plain board (4.1 GB at 350K rows) and keeps a second 350K-Listing snapshot: certain watchdog kill; restored rows also skip verification and scoring

FULLRUN_PERSIST.why: a fresh-only board replaces the cumulative one; pulled_sales then reads the whole prior board

FULLRUN_PRIOR_CORRECTION.why: turns off correct_prior_rows (fallback-point parcels, name-derived counties, exemption-claim withdrawal)

SCORE_BOARD_FAIL_SOFT.why: publishes stale HOT/WARM/COLD tiers when scoring fails

VERIFICATION_APPLY.why: refuted and stale verdicts would not remove their signals

FORECLOSURE_CHECKPOINT.why: no checkpoint: a crash costs the whole run and the gated publish has nothing to publish

ENRICH_PHASE_MAX_SECONDS.why: overrides every _await_capped / _gather_phases cap, including dot_ocr, rod_chain and nc_rod_render whose own budgets main.py passes as default_s (the 2026-09-23 dot_ocr zero-visibility bug)

unwired_allowlist.enrichment_greensboro_code: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): clone of charlotte_code (same broken FeatureServer URL, same workaround headers); the run's enrichment_code_enforcement reads Greensboro's own layer
unwired_allowlist.enrichment_irs_lien: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): CourtListener name search: first+last token of surname-first owner names, keywords that can never match, no amount, misses never stamped (the same 300 rows every run); a false federal lien would enter raw['liens'], which equity reads. Needs a rebuild before any wiring

unwired_allowlist.enrichment_marriage_license: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): the same Aumentum name search enrichment_aumentum_rod already runs (raw['rod']) through a curl_cffi impersonation adapter (BRIEF: never extend); 27 rows (22 no_match)
unwired_allowlist.enrichment_nc_doj: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): spoofed-browser 403 workaround (BRIEF); its landing-page branch ignores the name, so it would flag every NC row with the same alert list; 0 rows, nothing reads nc_doj
unwired_allowlist.enrichment_nc_onemap: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): parcel, flood and zoning already come from enrichment_arcgis / parcel_cache (NC1Map) and enrichment_flood; empty blocks are never retried; 0 rows, nothing reads nc_onemap
unwired_allowlist.enrichment_nc_sos: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): spoofed-browser 403 workaround (BRIEF); its batch merge has the shifted-index bug; the NC SOS lane runs on the Mac through enrichment_sos_agent / sos_dissolution

unwired_allowlist.enrichment_probate_search: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): a stealth browser written to get past an F5 anti-bot wall (BRIEF: never extend or run it); the SC URL puts a name where a case number goes and the NC regex reads any case-shaped text, and it would overwrite raw['probate'], which call_ready lane B reads
unwired_allowlist.enrichment_realtor_data: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): its TSV URL answers 404 (checked 2026-10-08); the research data moved to a different file with other columns; nothing reads housing_market (0 rows)
unwired_allowlist.enrichment_redfin_datacenter: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): its download URL is dead (404/429, docs/gap_closure_plan_2026-09-06.md); the live file is a 1.5 GB gzip it would read into memory whole; nothing reads market_stats (0 rows)
unwired_allowlist.enrichment_rod_name_index: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): curl_cffi impersonation (BRIEF: never extend); the run reads the same eight SC Online Record System counties plus Laurens and Lancaster through enrichment_generic_rod (FORECLOSURE_SC_ORS_ROD=1); 7 rows
unwired_allowlist.enrichment_sc_voter_xref: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): of 1,458 board phones from this lane 3 are corroborated (1,172 unverified, 283 contradicted): the phone gate makes the rest do_not_dial; it also builds an index over 565 MB of voter files
unwired_allowlist.enrichment_surface_contacts: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): copies agent / office phones into owner_phone, which then stops enrichment_voter_phone from finding the owner's own number on that row; its e-mail half is owner_email_of's job
unwired_allowlist.enrichment_usda_ers: RETIRED 2026-10-09 (audit unwired_enrichers; module and board keys kept, not run): the 3-digit county FIPS it reads is zero-padded to 5 and never matches, so every row gets {}; income and unemployment come from enrichment_census_demographics and valuation/location; economic on 0 rows

unwired_wire_pending.enrichment_onemap_sweeps: main.py, right after the enrich_with_rollback_exposure try/except (the 'Present-use / elderly DEFERRAL rollback' block, before 'Elderly/probate life-event tagging'; it MUST come after both tax_relief and the rollback block because it never overwrites their dollar figures): try: from .enrichment_onemap_sweeps import enrich_onemap_sweeps; s = await _await_capped(enrich_onemap_sweeps(enriched), "onemap_sweeps", default_s=900); if s and "skipped" not in s: enrichment_stats["onemap_sweeps"] = s; except Exception: log.error("onemap_sweeps.failed", traceback=traceback.format_exc()) (top80_checks: NC OneMap heir_estate + present-use sweeps; the screen ledger reads enrichment_stats['onemap_sweeps']['screened'])
unwired_wire_pending.gis_fill: main.py, right after the enrich_gis_attrs try/except (the 'GIS attribute backfill' block, before the Richland SC map-viewer reader): try: from .gis_fill import enrich_gis_fill; s = await _await_capped(enrich_gis_fill(enriched), "gis_fill", default_s=float(os.environ.get("FORECLOSURE_GIS_FILL_BUDGET_S", "2400")) + 180); if s and "skipped" not in s: enrichment_stats["gis_fill"] = s; except Exception: log.error("gis_fill.failed", traceback=traceback.format_exc()) (top80_fill)
unwired_wire_pending.enrichment_register_checks: main.py, in the register block right after the generic_rod stats loop (the 'for _rod_name in (... "generic_rod")' loop): try: from .enrichment_register_checks import enrich_register_checks; s = await _await_capped(enrich_register_checks(enriched), "register_checks", default_s=float(os.environ.get("FORECLOSURE_REGISTER_SWEEP_BUDGET_S", "1800")) + float(os.environ.get("FORECLOSURE_REGISTER_CHECKS_BUDGET_S", "900")) + 180); if s and "skipped" not in s: enrichment_stats["register_checks"] = s; except Exception: log.error("register_checks.failed", traceback=traceback.format_exc()) (top80_register_other)

unwired_wire_pending.enrichment_county_lien_sweep: main.py, in the register block right after the enrich_register_lien_sweep try/except (or, if that is not in yet, right after the enrich_nc_rod_render try/except): try: from .enrichment_county_lien_sweep import enrich_county_lien_sweep; s = await _await_capped(enrich_county_lien_sweep(enriched), "county_lien_sweep", default_s=float(os.environ.get("FORECLOSURE_COUNTY_SWEEP_BUDGET_S", "900")) + 240); if s and "skipped" not in s: enrichment_stats["county_lien_sweep"] = s; except Exception: log.error("county_lien_sweep.failed", traceback=traceback.format_exc()) (top80_register_cchs_kofile)

_unwired_doc: audit 2026-10-09 unwired_enrichers (docs/audit_2026-10-09/unwired_enrichers.md): every module the run does not reach is RETIRED with a reason (unwired_allowlist) or decided WIRE (unwired_wire_pending: the main.py line that wires it). The gate fails while a WIRE module is still unreached ('wiring pending'); once the lines are in, the entries here are tidied away (the gate says so).

board_load_allowlist.main:run: the GRANDFATHER_CARRIED=1 snapshot (json.loads of the whole prior plain board); unreachable while must_not_set holds GRANDFATHER_CARRIED
board_load_allowlist.enrichment_comps:carry_forward_from_boar: run_meta.json only (its run_time); the prior board itself is streamed with iter_board_rows_with_detail (fee0428a)

memory._growth_doc: next run's rows = prior board rows x growth_factor. The 10/6 run grew 223,832 -> 350,013 (x1.56) when the 10/7 sources landed; 1.15 assumes no new source of that size. Raise it when adding sources.

calibration.note: gated full run, exit 0, no swap used

memory._killed_doc: vm-run-20261007T233726 and vm-run-20261008T003844 were stopped by the watchdog at 25,629 / 25,606 MB 36 minutes in, in carryover (json.loads of the 4.1 GB prior board); fixed by d42058b3. Not calibration points: a defect, not a per-row cost.

handoff._doc: dir is the sharded hand-off (manifest.json + one JSON Lines shard per source) since 2026-10-09; file is the legacy single file, read as a fallback. The age is the newer of the two.

repo_size._doc: scripts/repo_size_check.py limits (prerun_gate repo-size, CI tests.yml job repo-size). The pre-commit gate refuses 95 MiB and GitHub 100 MiB per file; pages.yml stops a deploy at 950 MB and Pages refuses 1 GB.

frozen_keys_why.bankruptcy_petition: petition_address (scripts/bankruptcy_petition_sweep.py, an operator sweep outside the run); 0 rows on the 10/7 board
frozen_keys_why.campaign_queue: workflow_engine (scripts/enrich_board.py, hourly_refresh, neither run): retired, its min_equity trigger never fires (equity is a dict); 0 rows
frozen_keys_why.contact: contact_ingest (scripts/ingest_contacts.py, the operator's skip-trace file import); 0 rows on the 10/7 board

_frozen_doc: RAW_KEEP keys whose only writers are modules the run never imports (scripts/pipeline_wiring.raw_key_producers, 2026-10-09): their values on the board are whatever a script last wrote. Each needs a wire-or-retire decision; the gate fails on a NEW one. Since the unwired_enrichers audit (2026-10-09) the list holds only keys of retired modules or operator lanes outside the run; the keys of the eight wired modules (bt_appraisal_card, dnc_scrub, flood_zone, hud_fmr, land_distress, property_category, septic, wetlands) leave it.
